signals.text: 1 open PM role across 1 US office
Recently added to Tolara — hiring trends need a week of history

bullets: Own 20 to 30 customer accounts as their main point of contact, from kickoff through renewal
Run pilots from kickoff to readout and conversion: setup, tracking, success metrics, and the schedule to get there
Build an account plan for each customer, covering goals, what to test next, and how we'll know it worked
Work hands-on in each account, reviewing the agent's landing pages, keywords, and ads before they ship
Design and read experiments, and turn the results into a clear story for marketing teams and executives
